title: Our new school uniform!

before.predict: Look at the picture. What are the children wearing today?

text.title: First day in the new uniform
paragraphs: Nilufar: Good morning, Jasur! Are you wearing the new **uniform** today?
Jasur: Yes, I am! I am **wearing** a blue **shirt** and grey trousers. My mum is taking a **photo** of me now. She is very happy!
Nilufar: Me too! I am wearing a white shirt and a blue **skirt**. My little **sister** is wearing her uniform too, but it is too big for her! Mum says she can make it smaller tonight.
Jasur: Ha ha! What is your brother doing? Is he ready for school?
Nilufar: He is looking for his shoes. He is always late! Look — here is my **photo**. Do you like my uniform? They are under his bed, of course! Now he is running to the kitchen for breakfast.
Jasur: It is great! See you at school. You look very smart in it. My bus is coming now — bye!
